name: SVG Sticker Effect
description: A hand-drawn style SVG illustration turned into a die-cut sticker with a dilated outline, textured border, specular shine that follows the pointer, and a soft drop shadow.
contents: Inline SVG illustration styled as a sticker
Hidden SVG filter definition producing outline, shine and shadow
behavior: Specular light position follows the pointer across the window
Sticker scales fluidly with a minimum width of 200px
editableByProps: Shine strength, color, height and pointer following
Drop shadow offset, blur, color and opacity

needsCodeEdit.change: Replace the illustration with another SVG or image
needsCodeEdit.where: The svg with viewBox 885 1059 inside the div using ref stickerRef
nextjs-sticker-filter id and the filter url in the style of the sticker div

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Filter id is shared, so multiple instances on one page use the first filter definition
Listens to window pointer movement while followPointer is on and removes it on unmount
